  1

 2                                  PERSONAL INFORMATION:

 3   Q. Please state your name and address.

 4   A. My name is Jesse Preist. My address is 536 Fleeta Dr, Killeen, TX 76549

 5   Q. Have you filed a Motion to Intervene in this proceeding?

 6   A. Yes.

 7   Q. What link and tracts are you testifying in representation of today?

 8   A. G73

 9   Q. Are you testifying on behalf of anyone, or just yourself?

10   A. I am testifying on behalf of both my wife and myself

11   Q. How is the property affected by the Bell County East to Big Hill 765kV

12   transmission line project proposed by Oncor and LCRA TSC?

13   A. The property is traversed by the G73 link.

14   Q. What is the purpose of your testimony?

15   A. The purpose of my testimony is to inform the commission about concerns regarding

16   land use, cultural, impact, environmental impact, and health concerns associated with

17   the location of the G73 link

18   Q. What routes do you oppose?

19   A. I oppose the G73 route and it’s contagious links
                                                                 Direct Testimony of Jesse Priest
                                                                          PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                 SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                    Page 4 of 15
  1   Q. What routes do you support?

 2   A.

 3   Q. Have you ever testified at the Public Utility Commission of Texas before?

 4   A. No

 5   Q. Was this material prepared by you or under your supervision?

 6   A. yes

 7                         PROPERTY DESCRIPTION AND HISTORY

 8   Q. Can you please describe the affected property, including the legal description

 9   from the County CAD?

10        A. A0637BC W S NEWELL, TRACT 24 PT 23, ROCKING C EST, ACRES 5.97


11        B. A0637BC W S NEWELL, & A1092BC J B MCMAHON, ACRES 1.52


12   Q. Can you please explain your history and familiarity with the affected property,

13   including its current usage?

14   A. I purchased this property in July of 2023. I have been using the property as my

15   residence since January 2024. I am currently using the property as my personal

16   residence and family homestead.

17   Q. Can you please include any pictures with dates that depict the property and

18   how it is used?



                                                                  Direct Testimony of Jesse Priest
                                                                           PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                  SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                     Page 5 of 15
  1   A. Yes, photographs of the home in regards to the proximity and use of the home are

 2   included as exhibits.

 3   Q. Have the pictures been altered?

 4   A. No, other than labels.

 5   Q. Do the pictures accurately represent the views of the property?

 6   A. Yes.

 7                IMPACT ON LAND USE AND ECONOMICS (PURA § 37.056)

 8   Q. How would the proposed transmission line interfere with your current land

 9   use?

10   A. The primary purpose of the property is for our own personal residence and family

11   homestead. In addition, the creek and large trees were the primary reason for the

12   purchase of these parcels. Furthermore, several neighbors have permission from me to

13   use my property to access their land locked properties. The property is also open to

14   members of our church for their own personal enjoyment. The G73 line poses danger

15   as it is too close to our home and will also require the removal of all of the centuries old

16   trees along the creek, impacting the enjoyment and primary use of the property.

17   Q. Are there any specific structures or features that would be within 500 feet of

18   any of the proposed routes?




                                                                     Direct Testimony of Jesse Priest
                                                                              PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                     SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                        Page 6 of 15
  1   A. Yes. My home and residence. I am concerned that this habitation may not be

 2   reflected in the project mapping. I have attached exhibits to show the location of the

 3   residential habitation in regards to the proximity of the proposed G73 line.

 4   Q. In your opinion, how will this project affect the value of your land?

 5   A. In my opinion, there will be a negative impact on the value of the property as a whole

 6   as it can reduce the use of residential habitation and enjoyment of the property by the

 7   property owners and community.

 8   Q. Is there any evidence of American Indian campsites, dwellings, habitation sites,

 9   petroglyphs, artifacts, and other archeological resources that would be affected by link

10   G73?

11   There is a mound next to the creek directly underneath where the proposed G73 link will

12   be. I am asking the commission to avoid routing the G73 link through these properties,

13   or require a professional cultural resource investigation and appropriate consultation

14   before routing of the G73 link is approved.

15             ENVIRONMENTAL AND AESTHETIC IMPACTS (16 TAC § 25.101)

16   Q. What are your concerns regarding the local environment and wildlife?

17   A. There is a spring fed creek and riparian ecosystem in the valley. There is also a

18   seasonal marsh wetland adjacent the creek which is only known by the property owners

19   and local longtime residents of the community. The G73 link will bisect this ecosystem.

20   The removal of the riparian cover could displace the known wildlife in the area. I am

21   also concerned that the project would displace potential endangered species. My
                                                                     Direct Testimony of Jesse Priest
                                                                              PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                     SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                        Page 7 of 15
  1   neighbor, whose property surrounds mine to the north, east, and south, was denied for

 2   a cedar removal program through the VA because golden cheeked warbler and black

 3   cap vireo nests we determined to exist in the area. We have many old growth cedars on

 4   the property, and these parcels are in the center of that neighbor which was denied the

 5   VA cedar clearing program due to endangered habitat. I am asking the commission to

 6   avoid routing the G73 link through these properties, or require a professional

 7   environmental/wildlife resource investigation and appropriate consultation before routing

 8   of the G73 link is approved.

 9   Q. Were you provided sufficient notice by the Public Utility Commission and Oncor to

10   gather evidence supportive of the cultural resource claims provided in this testimony?

11   No. My first indication of the proposed G73 link was when I received a packet in the mail

12   near the end of March 2026. Since ownership in July 2023, I have been occupied in the

13   construction of my residence, I have not yet had the opportunity to fully assess the

14   environmental and cultural needs of the properties. I have been in contact with several

15   local residents in the community who have grown up here their entire lives and used this

16   and the contiguous properties prior to subdivision, and it is known throughout the

17   community to be a historically significant area. I am asking the commission to allow

18   more time given to conduct necessary, or avoid routing the G73 link altogether.

19   Q. How will the line affect the "aesthetic values" (the look and feel) of your area?

20   A. In my opinion, there will be a negative impact on the aesthetics of the area.

21                         LOCAL NEED AND COST (PURA § 37.056)

                                                                    Direct Testimony of Jesse Priest
                                                                             PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                       Page 8 of 15
  1   Q. Do you believe this project provides a direct benefit to your local electric

 2   service?

 3   A. No.

 4   Q. Do you believe this project will decrease your electric cost?

 5   A. No.

 6                         RECREATION AND COMMUNITY VALUES

 7   Q. How would this transmission line affect your enjoyment of your property?

 8   A. I will no longer desire to reside on this property as my personal residence, and the

 9   community that we have built will likely no longer desire nor be able to use it as it were.

10   This would cause my family to move to a different location.

11   Q. Do you think the proposed transmission line will affect any planned future use

12   on your land?

13   A. Yes. We had planned for a pecan orchard in the valley. If this G73 link is approved,

14   there will be no need to continue with those plans, and as stated before, we will have no

15   longer desire to use this property as our residence and family homestead.

16   Q. How would this transmission line affect your rural community values for your

17   area?

18   A. In my opinion, this transmission line will negatively affect my rural community values

19   of my area. I and my neighbors have invested a substantial amount of time and

20   resources into the enjoyment of the area as a whole by the local community. The
                                                                    Direct Testimony of Jesse Priest
                                                                             PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                       Page 9 of 15
  1   community will no longer be able to enjoy the area as it was, decreasing the value of the

 2   contiguous parcels.

 3                            CONCLUSIONS AND RECOMMENDATION

 4   Q. What is your recommendation to the Commission?


 5   A. I request that the Commission reject any route using Link G73. In the alternative, I request

 6   that any route involving G73 be modified to avoid the spring-fed creek corridor and nearby

 7   residences, and that no route be approved across this property without a professional cultural

 8   resources survey and consultation and a professional environmental/wildlife assessment.

 9   Q. Does this conclude your testimony?

10   A. Yes.

11   I, Jesse Priest, being duly sworn, state that the foregoing testimony is true and correct to the best

12   of my knowledge and belief.

13

14   Signed by Jesse Priest
